headline: Executive order aims to have essential medicines, medical supplies for emergencies, and their key ingredients made in the United States.
what_it_does: This order, signed in August 2020, directs the federal government to work toward making essential medicines, medical countermeasures such as treatments and supplies for health emergencies, and the raw materials used to make them inside the United States. It presents this as a way to prepare for public health emergencies and protect national security. Only the title was provided, so the specific steps and rules in the order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at increasing US-based production of essential medicines, emergency medical products, and their ingredients.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that buy or regulate medicines
who_it_affects.how: Agencies are expected to carry out the order's goal of relying more on medical products made in the United States.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 6, 2020; the exact start dates for specific actions are not stated in the title.
